svg.text: LLM Inference Kernel Library + Generator - BSR KV-Cache - JIT Attention - docs.flashinfer.ai
L2 - Inspector-Executor Interface (plan shapes/prefixes - launch tuned kernels)
Attention variant spec - KV layout - tile size heuristics
JIT compile or load prebuilt cubin/jit-cache module
Separate compile-time tile pick from runtime lengths
L3 - Unified Operator APIs (attention + GEMM + MoE + sampling + comm)
Paged + Ragged KV-Cache - GQA/MQA group size g
Auto-pick best impl per HW + workload
L4 - Unified KV-Cache Storage (BSR block-sparse + composable formats)
Unified abstraction: paged attn + radix tree + tree attn
Q/O packed without padding - shared indptr with K/V prefill
Compact multi-request batch into single tensor
Shared-prefix submatrices use larger Br blocks
No data movement - only index/pointer recomputation
LDGSTS 128B async copy - coalesced head_dim d
TMA on Hopper for contiguous KV - gather for sparse
L5 - Kernel Templates + JIT Compiler (CUDA/CUTLASS code generation)
FA3 WGMMA pipeline for Hopper SM90
Gather scattered tiles to SMEM for MMA
Query tile 1 uses CUDA cores - else tensor cores
Pick min Tq >= avg query len per batch
Maximize SM occupancy under reg/SMEM budget
Br aligned with Tq in BSR matrix
GQA: fuse query len with head group dim
CUDA code strings populate kernel template
Inspired by FlexAttention - specialize per model
Materialize only kernels used by target model
L6 - GPU Backends + Architecture Support (SM75 Turing through SM12.1 Blackwell)
Separate tile/variant selection from dynamic sequence scheduling
Compile: variant spec + task type (prefill/decode) + HW caps - JIT or load cubin
Plan: tile heuristics pick Tq/Tk - Br/Bc BSR layout - backend routing decision
Runtime: ragged batch pack - load-balanced work split - launch kernel grid
Output: Attention State [O,LSE] - optional compose for cascade/prefix/shared
Serve: CUDAGraph capture replay - torch.compile graph - framework step loop
First call: compile/download - subsequent: cache hit - offline: cubin + jit-cache packages
From arXiv 2501.01005 - block-sparse KV + JIT variants + dynamic scheduling
Why FlashInfer vs monolithic CUDA libs
FlashAttention - vLLM PagedAttn - stream-K - CUTLASS - AITemplate - FlexAttention
Goal: customizable high-perf attention engine without waiting for new monolithic libs
L7 - Design Position (Inference Kernel Layer below serving frameworks)
Not a full engine - reusable GPU ops + codegen - frameworks plug in via PyTorch/DLPack
Init: pip install - first op triggers JIT/cubin load - show-config verifies arch/CUDA - optional jit-cache for offline
